description: Call this tool to render the A4 completion report of one work order and return a download link valid for one hour: the lines, the hours, the materials, the totals and the sign-off block. Pro.

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. harbour-cafe-report. Defaults to the work order id; the report comes back as a download link valid for one hour

work_order.description: The work order id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, or the client name when only one job is theirs

name: completion_report_pdf
title: Completion report as a PDF
